units.note: Counted in 2011 as part of undivided Andhra Pradesh. These figures are the 13 districts that stayed in the state, added up from the district table. Some mandals of Khammam district moved to Andhra Pradesh in 2014, which this split does not reflect.

units.cn: Also the capital of Punjab and Haryana

units.n: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
units.note: Two separate Union Territories in 2011. These figures add Dadra and Nagar Haveli to Daman and Diu. The very low sex ratio reflects the many male migrant workers counted there.
The National Capital Territory. It has an elected legislature, and its 2011 urban share is the highest of any state or Union Territory.

Counted in 2011 as one state with Ladakh. These figures are the state's 20 non-Ladakh districts added up. Density is left out for this unit and for Ladakh because the area figure depends on which parts of the region are counted.

units.note: Kerala is the only state with more women than men in the 2011 count, with Puducherry the only Union Territory.
Counted in 2011 as part of Jammu and Kashmir. These figures are the Leh and Kargil districts added up. Density is left out because the area figure depends on which parts of the region are counted.
